evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 6.2 ppm, near the established post-purge baseline of roughly 3–6 ppm.
Exhaust oxygen increased to 14.8 ppm during unchanged growth setpoints.
Exhaust oxygen rose further to 19.4 ppm, indicating a developing atmosphere deviation.
Temperature 750.1 °C tracks the 750 °C setpoint; argon 99.6 sccm tracks 100 sccm; pressure remains stable at 760.8 Torr and heater power is 43.5%.
